name: (ULTIMATE) DIRTY DEEDS DONE DIRT CHEAP
description: Based on the Ultimate D4C stand created by Kars, featured in the Jorge Joestar light novel. Incredibly well-done skin with custom VFX. Recieved NEW SFX this latest update (2.5), being Kars inspired.

name: (FULLY AGED) DIRTY DEEDS DONE DIRT CHEAP
description: A D4C Skin based on it's final appearance after being hit with the Infinite rotation shot in JJBA P7 (SBR). Incredily detailed skin that comes with its own unique SFX and VFX for all of its moves.

name: RUNIC TUSK
description: A Runic Remodelling of Tusk that features a unique design on each act based on Runes and Seasons. All acts feature unique Nail bullet colours corresponding with their primary colour. TA1 with Pink nails, Ta2 with Blue, Ta3 with Orange/red

name: DIRTY DEEDS DONE DIRT CHEAP
description: The stand of the main P7 antagonist, utilising its dimension hopping ability to bring in clones to fight for you, as well as being able to hide and bring others into its own dimension.

name: (DESTROYED) DIRTY DEEDS DONE DIRT CHEAP

name: PLUSH D4C
description: A decrepit plushy remodel with a purple and dark blue colourway, having a broken bunny ear. Credits to @l3io0177 for the skin concept.

name: TUSK ACT 1-4
description: The stand of the protagonist of P7 JJBA. Tusk's obtainment from Left arm is 6%. Tusk consists of 4 different acts from act 1-4.

name: NATURE D4C
description: A new skin rework that replaced its previous design, Mint D4C. Features Glowing VFX with trailing leaves falling around the body. Has a unique green colour when going into Love Train.

name: DEIMOS CRAZY DIAMOND
description: A custom remodel of the original Crazy Diamond model, directly inspired by the original work of the digital artist Deimos Art. Has custom SFX and VFX.

name: KING CRIMSON REQUIEM (FALSE REQUIEM)
description: A overhaul of the normal Kc making it appear like a False Requiem , with a cape addition.

name: "GOODRA" (EOH) TUSK ACT 1-4
description: Custom voicelines and sound effects. The first tusk skin to be released, with the colorway of Goodra from "Pokémon", and SFX from Tusk in "EOH". Has a unique colorway for Tusk Act 1-4.

name: (FRANK) HORROR DIRTY DEEDS DONE DIRT CHEAP
description: A D4C skin based on the film DONNIE DARKO. Skin compossed of only a single Donnie Darko roblox UGC and roblox clothing. Black LoveTrain colour.

name: TWITTER TUSK ACT 1-4
description: Custom Twitter sound effects and colorway. Makes a small twitter tweet noise when equipping nails (E). Has a unique colorway for Tusk Act 1-4.

name: IRON (MK1) WHITE ALBUM
description: A fully custom White Album skin based on Iron Man's MK1 (Mark 1) suit which he built in captivity of the Ten Rings. Features custom sfx.

name: DANTE HAND / THE WARLORD
description: A full remodel, made based on the design of Dante, the Chapter Master of the Blood Angels from Warhammer 40K. Changes all the erasure VFX to be red and has custom SFX.

name: THE WORLD: OVA
description: Voiceline changest to moves + Base TW Value + Nostalgia from past roblox jojo games.

name: DUELIST CHOCOLATE DISCO
description: A custom skin for Chocolate Disco based on a player suggestion with reference to Yu Gi Oh Duel Disk.

name: VAMPIRIC MANDOM
description: A full remodel, based entirely on the Vampire Core in game, present within the Vampiric dimension.

name: QUICKSTER WHITE ALBUM
description: White Album skin based on the Spongebob character known as "The Quickster", also has custom SFX.

name: DIO'S THE WORLD
description: Animated Gears + Custom SFX from Jumpforce. Slight Remodel based on the P3 JJBA Anime design of The World.

name: SHADOW THE WORLD : ALTERNATE UNIVERSE
description: Greatly made as well as possesing a nostalgic factor due to being popular in older jojo games. Custom remodel aswell as custom SFX.

name: ARCADE STAR PLATINUM THE WORLD
description: A Skin of Star Platinum: The World Based on the Arcade edition of Heritage For The Future for The Playstation 1. Features a custom idle animation and has upcoming voice lines from Heritage For The Future soon.

name: RAYQUAZA C-MOON
description: A skin remodel based on the legendary pokemon Rayquaza. Has custom SFX on some of its moves.

name: 049 GREENDAY
description: A Green day skin based on SCP-049 , featuring custom SFX.

name: BOOM, BOOMBOOM, BOOMBOOMBOOM METALLICA
description: A full custom model design for Metallica, based on "Tomb of the Boom", the shared Stand of the Boom Boom Family, featured in the 7th part of JJBA, Steel Ball Run. In all three versions, it possesses an elongated face with a long tongue coming out of a small mouth, resembling that of a giant anteater.

name: SEAMINE MANDOM
description: A full remodel of the stand, its design being based off of a real life sea mine.

name: EMPEROR CRIMSON
description: A partial remodel and recolour of the base Emperor model, based on the design of the part 5 stand, King Crimson.

name: SUNKEN SOFT AND WET / SOFT AND SUNKEN
description: High quality Soft And Wet skin inspired by a sunken ship within the depths of the sea. Has unqiue oceanic features and custom Spongebob SFX.

name: KILLELUGA / BATTLE CATS KILLER QUEEN
description: A partial remodel and recolour of the base Killer Queen model. Based on the Battle Cats game. Has custom cat SFX and a unique SHA.

name: KORN HEYYA
description: A full model redesign of Hey Ya based on Korn's iconic "Issues" album which features a ragdoll on the cover design.

name: ISSAC PRESIDENT
description: A full remodel of the Mr President key, inspired by the indie game Binding of Isaac. Has a custom double room.

name: MOTH 20TH CENTURY BOY
description: A skin based on a moth, full remodel as well as giving the user wings and antennae. The wings on the model feature actual movement physics

name: CHOCOLATE STEAMPUNK
description: Complete design change of the stand to look like a Steampunk gear mechanism.

name: DISCO CRAZY DIAMOND
description: Latest Crazy Diamond skin and a great one at that. Currently the ONLY skin in the game with colour changing features that also affect its vfx when in heal mode. RGB colouring done amazing and skin done well. | Model additions as well as Aura changes to make it shine more have been added

name: HEAVY WEATHER
description: A custom skin for Weather Report based on a suggestion , doesnt feature any sfx or vfx.

name: HAZMAT HAZE
description: A full remodel, featuring a full yellow hazmat suit with a darkened face cover. Has custom zombie inspired SFX.

name: SPONGEBOB MR. PRESIDENT (MR. PINEAPPLE)
description: Visual Rework of Mr President featuring Spongebob's Spatula as the key, Spongebob inspired room.

name: STAR FLATINUM
description: Unique remodel of Star Platinum's default model. Custom SFX on its moves aswell. 1/6 due to the plethora of other Star Platinum skins in game.

name: HERITAGE FOR THE FUTURE : STAR PLATINUM
description: Custom Voice Lines from HFTF on certain moves. Decently well done colourway. Gives nostalgia factor for jojo fans who have played Heritage for the Future. Fairly good demand.

name: RETRO STAR PLATINUM
description: Custom remodel based on the OVA Anime of JJBA, having custom SFX and a good colourway. 1/6 chance to roll from skin farming Star Platinum.

name: KING WHITESNAKE / KINGSNAKE
description: White Snake skin inspired by the concept of a Crusader knight. Features custom VFX and pull out SFX.

name: COWGIRL STONE FREE
description: A Custom skin of Stone Free based on a suggestion.

name: PURPLE STAR PLATINUM: OVA
description: Yet another recolour of an already succesful skin. Purple being a much more favourable colour over the rest of the SPOVA recolours.

name: YELLOW STAR PLATINUM: OVA
description: Recolour of base Star Platinum based on the JJBA Part 3 Anime. Decent colourway.

name: YELLOW STAR PLATINUM
description: A Yellow Recolour of Star Platinum, based on his "Judgement" beatdown on Kakyoin during Part 3. Guaranteed on evolution to turn into a Shiny SPTW.

name: CRACKED GOLDEN EXPERIENCE
description: Base model with added cracks, referencing the final Diavolo fight from JJBA Part 5.

name: TOXIC GOLDEN EXPERIENCE
description: Nostalgic stand skin from older JoJo Roblox games, grey/dark grey and neon green recolour.

name: WHITE: GOLDEN EXPERIENCE
description: Silver and gold recolour of Golden Experience.

name: SILVER GOLDEN EXPERIENCE
description: Blue and Silver recolour of the default Golden Experience model.

name: MANGA KING CRIMSON
description: Remodel and custom SFX along with Custom Epitaph. Based on King Crimsons manga design.

name: GREEN DAY
description: The stand of Cioccolata, featured in the 5th of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Golden Wind. It is a humanoid Stand that can generate and spread a deadly mold. Said mold will trigger and consume any lifeform whose altitude decreases.

name: WHITE ALBUM
description: The stand of Ghiaccio from Part 5 of JJBA, a stand in the form of a suit of armour and ice skates, allowing the user to freeze objects and create ice constructs. Only obtainable during winter with an 8% from any corpse part.

name: METALLICA
description: The stand of Risotto Nero from Part 5 JJBA, is a stand which manipulates iron in the air and inside living bodies allowing users to create lethal objects like razers and needles , can also bend light to make the user partially invisible.

name: C-MOON
description: The evolved stand of Pucci from Part 6 of JJBA, being the evolution of Whitesnake after fusing with the Green Baby. This stand has the ability to control gravity and reverse an objects center of gravity with its fist.

name: OBSIDIAN CMOON
description: A purple recolour of C-moon's base model, likely inspired by ABD's G-MOON.

name: THE WORLD
description: The stand of the antagonist of P1 and P3 of JJBA, appearing in P3. Reliable with several decent moves and the only timestop based stand with a mobility move. Lost popularity due to several direct and indirect Timestop nerfs.

name: KING CRIMSON
description: The stand of the final antagonist of JJBA P5, possesing high destructive power but a high stamina drain. Fairly good for PvP. Rare stand rarity.

name: GOLDEN EXPERIENCE
description: The stand of the P5 JJBA protagonist. Able to create several lifeforms to assist you in combat as well as having a healing move.

name: OASIS
description: The the Stand of Secco, featured in the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Vento Aureo. Oasis is a suit that covers the user and grants the user the ability to liquefy the ground and can also traverse through it by diving in the ground.

name: BLUE C-MOON
description: A blue recolour of C-moon's base model with custom sfx.

name: NERF EMPEROR
description: A recolour of the base Emperor model, inspired by a NERF gun, makes the colour of your bullets orange.

name: GRIME WHITE SNAKE
description: Almost identical to the base model of WS, save for the clothing being darker and the eyes having several dark slits on them. Has pre-rework Whitesnake SFX.

name: MINT : WHITESNAKE
description: A custom recolour of base Whitesnake, present in a plethora of other Roblox JoJo games.

name: WHITESNAKE
description: The stand of the main antagonist of P6 JJBA, a stand based around taking away your opponents stand ability for a set duration. One of the least popular rare rarity stands.

name: STAR PLATINUM
description: Iconic stand from JJBA Part 3. Somewhat decent kit and good design. By stealing a timestop with SP, you have a good chance of obtaining a Stars Essence, allowing you to evolve it into SPTW. Rare stand rarity.

name: STAR PLATINUM: THE WORLD
description: The evolution of Star Platinum. | After recent update, obtainment of this stand has been made MUCH easier than before, with the addition of the star essence. Fairly decent for PvP yet less popular than its base variant.

name: MR PRESIDENT
description: The stand of soul swapped Polnareff from Part 5 of JJBA, with the ability to transport people into a small pocket dimension in the form of a room.

name: THE WORLD : ALTERNATE UNIVERSE
description: The stand of AU Diego Brando in JJBA Part 7 | Rare stand rarity as well as being fairly capable for PvP.

name: 20TH CENTURY KNIGHT
description: A unique skin with a knight design for the stand, 20th Century Boy.

name: STAR PLATINUM THE WORLD : STONE OCEAN
description: A recolour of the base SPTW model, based on P6 appearance of Star Platinum. This is the only skin in game that has an exclusive move, chaging triple bearing shot for a single spear throw that ragdolls.

name: SOFT AND WET : ROBO
description: Robotic Redesign of Soft and Wet. Very great design despite being simple . Base stand is same rarity as other rare stands it's also pretty capable in PVP

name: THE WORLD: GREATEST HIGH
description: Voiceline changes aswell as nostalgia from past roblox jojo games, on top of overall cool colourway.

name: [ FINAL ORA ] AZURE STAR PLATINUM : THE WORLD
description: A recolour of the base SPTW model, based on Part 4 of Jotaro's final beatdown on Yoshikage Kira. Custom voiceline for it's V move. Pretty good colourway and visual appeal.

name: HIEROPHANT GREEN: OVA

name: HOLLY'S HERMIT PURPLE

name: THE HAND: THE WORLD
description: A golden recolour of the hand's default model, has custom SFX and VFX on its erasure based moves.

name: OVA SILVER CHARIOT
description: The design of Silver Chartion from the OVA version of JJBA Part 3, featuring custom OVA SFX.

name: GHOSTLY KILLER QUEEN
description: Based on the first appearance of Killer Queen in the Part 4 Anime. Custom model has visible dark aura and effects. Has custom SFX. Its new refresh boosted the skin's value significantly.

name: MINTY FINGERS
description: A minty-green recolour of the base model of Sticky Fingers, based on the Thumbnail photo for Bridger Western

name: ENCHAINED OH LONESOME ME

name: BALL BREAKER

name: OVA: CREAM

name: THE HAND

name: ZEUS REPORT

name: VOID CREAM

name: STYLIZED EMPEROR
description: A blue/purple recolour of the base Emperor model

name: WEATHER REPORT
description: The stand of Weather/Wes Bluemarine from P6 JJBA, a stand with the ability to manipulate the weather and bring forth devastating natural... disasters.

name: PURPLE EMPEROR
description: A purple recolour of the base Emperor model.

name: KC MANDOM

name: NEO SOFT AND WET

name: MONOCHROMATIC: THE HAND
description: A black and white recolour of The Hand's base model.

name: OVA EMPEROR
description: A golden/yellow recolour of Emperor.

name: CREAM
description: The stand of Vanilla Ice, capable of dipping itself and the user into a void dimension, absorbing anything in its path into said dimension and obliterating it.

name: SOFT AND WET
description: The stand of the main protagonist in Part 8 of JJBA. Rare stand rarity and very capable in PvP.

name: GOLDEN SOFT AND WET
description: Gold and green recolour of base Soft and Wet with custom SFX. Based on an eyecatcher from Part 8 of JJBA.

name: EMPEROR
description: The stand of Hol Horse, appearing in Part 3 of JJBA. A gun with the stand ability to generate and shoot homing bullets. 8% from any corpse part while holding a revolver.

name: SILVER: SIX PISTOLS

name: PURPLE: SIX PISTOLS

name: OVA: THE FOOL
description: The OVA recolour of The Fool from the OVA of JJBA P3.

name: "ZOMBIE" WORLD
description: Custom model as well as custom SFX (Shared with TWHG). Fairly unpopular due to being majorly disliked by the community.

name: CHEF KING CRIMSON

name: MONOCHROMATIC (OREO) KING CRIMSON

name: GREEN MANDOM
description: Green recolour of mandom, rare stand rarity.

name: CRAZY DIAMOND

name: CATCH THE RAINBOW

name: SILVER CHOCOLATE DISCO
description: A Silver recolouring of base Chocolate Disco.

name: YELLOW CRAZY DIAMOND
description: Green and yellow recolour of Crazy Diamond.

description: White and purple recolour for Purple Haze. Based on the Purple Haze Feedback Novel by Kouhei Kadono. Posesses a custom posion cloud colour unique to the skin.

name: PURPLE HAZE: GREEN
description: Green recolour of base Purple Haze.

name: LEAN HIEROPHANT GREEN
description: Purple Recolour of Hierophant Green.

description: Black Recolour of Hierophant Green

description: Blue recolour of Hermit Purple.

name: YELLOW HIEROPHANT GREEN
description: Yellow recolour of Hierophant Green.

name: AMERICAN TUBULAR BELLS
description: Changes the orange default background of Tubular Bells to the colourway of the United States flag. Special Eagle sfx when Balloons pop

name: PURPLE HAZE
description: A stand featured in P5 JJBA, with its main ability being the creation and explosive release of a highly dangerous virus that hurts the opponent and user alike.

name: OH LONESOME ME
description: A stand featured in P7 JJBA, allowing the user to split their body into several pieces while being held together by rope. Guaranteed stand from a Corpse Part if a lasso is held out while merging with one.

name: SILVER CHARIOT

name: TUBULAR BELLS
description: A stand present in P7 JJBA, able to create metallic balloons to seek and harm a target.

name: STAND DISC
description: Universal storage for stands, allowing you to change stands at will between current and stored. Currenbtly only obtainable through a robux purchase and the Pucci quest.

name: ROKAKAKA SEED
description: WHEN TRADING SEEDS, IT'S RECOMMENDED TO HAVE A MIDDLEMAN TO MONITOR. PLEASE NOTE THAT ROKAKAKA FRUIT SPAWNS RANGE FROM 1-3, SO GETTING 3 FRUITS IS NOT GUARANTEED.

name: 50K MOOLA
description: In game currency, used as adds in trading.

name: DOGBANE HERB
description: An item possesing several possible purpouses: Being able to reset your stand, reset spin, de-age the player by 20 years or can be sold for 2.5k Moola. Great add in trading.

name: KHNUM
description: Part 3 stand that confers the ability to change shape to its user. Currently unobtainable. Possibly turning into a unobtainable skin in the future for an upcoming stand named 'Cream Starter', a part 7 stand.

name: SMOKE HAZE
description: Specialized, smoke-themed skin distinguished by its heavy-duty gas mask and dark, tactical design. Inspired by Smoke from Rainbow Six Siege and features unique VFX.

name: WHATSAPP D4C
description: A Green and white recolour of the base D4C model based on the Whatsapp application, with custom Whatsapp themed SFX.

name: WRECKING BALL BREAKER
description: The orange recolour of Ball Breaker, obtained by buying wrecking balls from Wekapipo during the winter season.
